question: Anurag starts from Point Y and drives 11 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 25 km, turns right and drives 27 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a right turn, drives 41 km. He then turns left, drives 14 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution: Given: 1) Anurag starts from Point Y and drives 11 km towards North. 2) He then takes a right turn, drives 25 km, turns right and drives 27 km. 3) He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. 4) He takes a right turn, drives 41 km.
